events.title: US government shutdown ends after 43 days
events.why_it_matters: Ends the longest shutdown in US history, restoring federal operations and data releases.
events.what_to_watch: Backlogged economic data and any lingering agency funding gaps.

events.title: US final reciprocal tariff list; Canada raised to 35%
events.why_it_matters: Final reciprocal tariffs cover 99.4% of US imports, raising input costs and retaliation risk.
events.what_to_watch: Mexico steel and vehicle talks; any WTO challenges.

events.title: SEC proposes crypto asset custody rules
events.why_it_matters: Clarifies custody framework, potentially unlocking institutional crypto allocation.
events.what_to_watch: Comment period and final rule timing.

events.title: FTC secures Corteva pesticide antitrust settlement
events.why_it_matters: Settlement constrains loyalty rebates, affecting agrochemical pricing.
events.what_to_watch: Follow-on private litigation and FTC enforcement posture.

events.title: Continuing resolution funds government through Dec 11; shutdown risk Dec 12
events.why_it_matters: A funding lapse would hit federal contractors, data releases, and risk sentiment.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a short-term CR is passed or spending talks stall.

events.title: US midterm elections November 3
events.why_it_matters: Divided government or Democratic sweep could shift fiscal, tax, and regulatory expectations.
events.what_to_watch: Prediction markets price ~90% chance Democrats win at least one chamber.

events.title: Paramount Skydance closes $110B Warner Bros Discovery acquisition
events.why_it_matters: Creates a media giant; antitrust litigation continues in lower courts.
events.what_to_watch: Ninth Circuit appeal and any conditions on release windows.

events.title: India Supreme Court strikes down Yes Bank AT1 write-off
events.why_it_matters: Restores ₹8,415 crore to bondholders, setting precedent for AT1 instruments.
events.what_to_watch: Bank capital planning and potential RBI response.

events.title: US September payrolls +29K, far below consensus
events.why_it_matters: Weak labor market reduces pressure for an October Fed hike, supporting bonds and growth stocks.
events.what_to_watch: Revisions and whether the Fed shifts its hike to December.

events.title: US September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y, above expectations
events.why_it_matters: Sticky inflation keeps the Fed hawkish and raises the bar for rate cuts.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI 2.6% y/y; PCE on Oct 29 for confirmation.

events.title: US September retail sales +0.3%, modest
events.why_it_matters: Consumer spending holds up but at a slower pace, consistent with Beige Book caution.
events.what_to_watch: Holiday season guidance from retailers.

events.title: Fed Beige Book shows modest growth, rising price pressures
events.why_it_matters: Supports a hawkish hold at the October FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: FOMC statement language on inflation and growth.

events.title: FOMC meeting Oct 27-28; hold expected, December hike live
events.why_it_matters: Decision sets the tone for rates into year-end; market prices ~15% hike probability.
events.what_to_watch: Statement, dot plot (no SEP this meeting), and Warsh press conference.

events.title: US Q3 GDP advance estimate Oct 29
events.why_it_matters: GDPNow tracks ~4.6%, but shutdown data gaps may distort the print.
events.what_to_watch: Consumption and inventory contributions.

events.title: US PCE inflation September Oct 29
events.why_it_matters: Fed's preferred inflation gauge; a hot print would cement December hike.
events.what_to_watch: Consensus around 3.4% y/y headline.

events.title: ECB meeting Oct 29; hold expected, December hike signaled
events.why_it_matters: ECB likely holds at 2.5% but points to December; euro and bunds sensitive.
events.what_to_watch: Lagarde's language on energy prices and growth.

events.title: BOJ meeting Oct 29-30; hold expected, December hike live
events.why_it_matters: BOJ likely holds at 1.25% but keeps December hike on table; yen and JGBs in focus.
events.what_to_watch: Quarterly outlook and Governor Ueda's press conference.

events.title: Japan September national CPI Oct 23
events.why_it_matters: Tokyo CPI already at 2.8%; national print informs BOJ December decision.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI consensus ~2.1%.

events.title: China Q3 GDP +4.5% y/y, beats consensus
events.why_it_matters: Growth at bottom of target range; exports strong, consumption and property weak.
events.what_to_watch: Policy support at the Financial Street Forum and PBoC easing.

events.title: China September industrial production +5.5%, retail sales +1.1%
events.why_it_matters: Confirms two-speed economy: factories strong, households cautious.
events.what_to_watch: Stimulus measures ahead of year-end.

events.title: South Korea BOK decision Oct 22; hold expected, November hike live
events.why_it_matters: BOK likely holds at 3.00% but keeps November hike on table; KRW sensitive.
events.what_to_watch: Hawkish dissents and inflation forecast.

events.title: Netflix Q3 earnings Oct 20
events.why_it_matters: Ad-tier and engagement trends set tone for streaming sector.
events.what_to_watch: Revenue consensus $12.86B; subscriber metrics.

events.title: Tesla Q3 earnings Oct 21
events.why_it_matters: Robotaxi and AI spending vs auto margin focus.
events.what_to_watch: EPS consensus ~$0.44; energy storage and FSD progress.

events.title: Meta Q3 earnings Oct 21
events.why_it_matters: AI ad tools and capex guidance key for mega-cap tech sentiment.
events.what_to_watch: Revenue consensus ~$63.3B; Reality Labs losses.

events.title: Microsoft Q1 FY27 earnings Oct 28
events.why_it_matters: Azure AI growth and capex are key for cloud/AI trade.
events.what_to_watch: Azure growth and Copilot monetization.

events.title: Alphabet Q3 earnings Oct 27/28
events.why_it_matters: Google Cloud and AI search monetization in focus.
events.what_to_watch: Cloud revenue growth and capex.

events.title: Apple Q4 FY26 earnings Oct 29
events.why_it_matters: iPhone demand and AI features set tone for hardware supply chain.
events.what_to_watch: EPS consensus $1.98; Greater China.

events.title: Amazon Q3 earnings Oct 29
events.why_it_matters: AWS growth and retail margin key for consumer/cloud read-through.
events.what_to_watch: AWS revenue and advertising.

events.title: Korean IPO wave: Elice Group and others list Oct 19-23
events.why_it_matters: Tests KOSDAQ appetite amid chip-led export boom.
events.what_to_watch: Subscription ratios and first-day pops.

events.title: Middle East tensions: Iran-Israel, Houthi attacks, Brent ~$110
events.why_it_matters: Supply disruption risk keeps oil elevated, feeding inflation and geopolitical risk premium.
events.what_to_watch: Strait of Hormuz traffic and Saudi infrastructure attacks.

events.title: OPEC+ meeting November 1 to review output
events.why_it_matters: Decision on December output amid elevated prices and Iran risk.
events.what_to_watch: Saudi-Russia coordination and compliance.

events.title: Japan LDP wins supermajority in lower house election
events.why_it_matters: Political stability supports Abenomics-style policies and BOJ normalization path.
events.what_to_watch: Fiscal stimulus and BOJ appointments.

events.title: Samsung Biologics strike planned Oct 26
events.why_it_matters: CDMO supply disruption risk for global biopharma.
events.what_to_watch: Court mediation and production continuity.

events.title: POSCO partial strike over wages
events.why_it_matters: Steel output disruption could ripple into autos and shipbuilding.
events.what_to_watch: Whether strike expands to full walkout.

events.title: Atlantic hurricane season activity below normal but non-tropical low off SE coast
events.why_it_matters: Low probability of major hurricane, but any Gulf landfall would hit energy and insurers.
events.what_to_watch: NHC 7-day outlook.

top_risks: Middle East escalation pushing Brent above $120 and reigniting global inflation.
Hot September PCE on Oct 29 forcing a December Fed hike, tightening financial conditions.
Government shutdown risk after Dec 11 disrupting federal data and contractor spending.
Mega-cap earnings disappointments, particularly on AI capex and cloud growth.
US midterm outcome creating fiscal and regulatory uncertainty into year-end.
top_opportunities: Fed hold on Oct 28 could spark a relief rally in rate-sensitive sectors.
China policy stimulus response to weak consumption and property could lift cyclicals.
Strong Korean chip exports and AI capex cycle support technology hardware.
OPEC+ restraint and Middle East risk premium support energy equities.
Biotech IPO window showing signs of reopening (Iambic, Korean listings).
summary: Markets enter the last two weeks of October with a hawkish Fed on hold, elevated oil prices from Middle East tensions, and a heavy mega-cap earnings slate. China Q3 GDP met the bottom of its target range but showed a two-speed economy. Key near-term catalysts are the Oct 28 FOMC, Oct 29 PCE/GDP data, and the Nov 1 OPEC+ meeting, with US midterms looming on Nov 3.
